title: Synthetic LMED prescriptions in the 2023 column layout — fake_lmed_2023
text: Synthetic. Generated `dev/generate_fake_lmed.R`   `set.seed(42)`, identical [fake_lmed_2026] except person   identifier named `p1163_lopnr_personnr` rather `lopnr`. Together   [fake_skeleton_mht] deliberately spans 312 ISO weeks (2015-W02   2020-W52, six ISO years), 156-week minimum-duration rule   reachable: one person's treatment episode runs longer 156 weeks   another's runs shorter. fixture also contains prescription gaps   four weeks (bridged) four weeks (bridged),   one person clashing concurrent prescriptions, least one product   per reachable product category, one product name absent   category ladder.

title: mht: Menopausal hormone therapy exposure definitions for Swedish registry data — mht-package
text: Derives menopausal hormone therapy (MHT) exposure Swedish prescription registry (LMED) data. Categorises dispensed product names MHT groups, corrects dispensed durations, bridges gaps consecutive prescriptions, applies approach-based exposure definitions used Skalkidou-lab MHT studies person-week skeletons.

title: mht 26.7.31
text: First release. mht carries MHT-specific code previously lived swereg, extracted package MHT exposure definitions can versioned reviewed separately general registry tooling. Function names drop mht infix, package name now supplies . swereg::x2023_mht_add_lmed() becomes mht::x2023_add_lmed(), swereg::x2026_mht_add_lmed() becomes mht::x2026_add_lmed(). See migration map README.md. mht depend swereg. operates person-week skeletons form swereg produces, takes plain data.table arguments, two packages can installed upgraded independently.
